    ServerSessionRegistry - Class in it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.helper
    In-memory store of server-side session and lobby state, backed by a set of plain HashMaps: sessionsById: session ID to its mutable ServerSessionRegistry.SessionState (connection, optional User, ServerSessionRegistry.Phase, current lobby/game ID, last pong timestamp). sessionIdByNickname: authenticated nickname to its session ID, used to enforce nickname uniqueness and to look a session up by nickname. reconnectGameIdByNickname: nickname of a disconnected player to the game ID it may reconnect to (the reconnect slot). lobbyModels: lobby ID to its Lobby model, with nextLobbyId handing out sequential IDs. activeLobbyControllers / activeGames: lobby/game ID to the LobbyController / GameController currently handling it (the routing table used to dispatch work to the right controller thread).
